articles.title: Putin notes formation of partnerships by Russian Export Center with friendly states
articles.summary: Putin met with Russian Export Center Director General Veronika Nikishina to discuss the establishment of sustainable partnerships with friendly countries to increase exports.

articles.title: Kremlin spokesman comments on Putin-Trump call, Russia-China drills
articles.summary: Kremlin Spokesman Dmitry Peskov addressed Putin's telephone conversation with US President Donald Trump and Russia's joint naval drills with China.

articles.title: Putin gives signal to US about imminent liberation of Donbass
articles.summary: A State Duma deputy noted that Putin's position in resolving the Russia-Ukraine conflict has been key to US interest in maintaining dialogue.

articles.title: Russia-China joint naval drills not aimed against anyone — Kremlin
articles.summary: Kremlin Spokesman Peskov stated that the Russia-China Joint Sea 2026 naval exercise is not directed against any country and represents important security cooperation.

articles.title: Trump's call with Putin shows Russia-US dialogue maintained, lawmaker argues
articles.summary: A State Duma lawmaker noted that Putin's telephone conversation with Trump demonstrated continued direct dialogue between Russia and the United States.
